about_the_game:
🌀 DARKZAN ARENA: MAADNESS 🌀

Sanity is a luxury... and you’ve already lost it.

In the depths of infinity, Maadness, the Supreme Entity of the Mind, was once the wisest of the primordials. But countless eras of contemplation condemned him to madness. Now, his influence spreads across the Arena, distorting reality, corrupting thoughts, and turning warriors into mere puppets of his insanity.

Will you resist the madness... or lose yourself in the chaos of your own mind?

🧠 THE REALM OF MADNESS CALLS! 🧠

Darkzan Arena: Maadness introduces a unique and unsettling experience, where nothing is as it seems, and logic bends under the insanity of the Mind Lord.

Prepare for surreal challenges, unpredictable enemies, and weapons beyond comprehension.

🔮 WHAT’S NEW?

✅ 50+ New Items – Chaotic weapons, distorted gear, and mind-bending artifacts.
✅ 15+ New Enemies – Unreal creatures, specters of madness, and warriors consumed by insanity.
✅ New Challenges – Face ever-changing arenas and unpredictable foes.
✅ Hallucinatory Visual Effects – Reality shatters under the presence of Maadness.

⚔️ DIVE INTO THE ABYSS OF INSANITY! ⚔️

The mind is your greatest weapon... but what if you can’t trust it anymore?

Enter the Arena of Maadness, where the only certainty is absolute chaos!
